characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If this model is not **battle-shocked** you can use this ability in your command phase. Select 1 **vehicle** or **walker** model withing 3" of this model then make a **repair roll** on 1D6:
- On a x+: **Heal(1)**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can join **Walker** units as well as its regular leader options.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When a model with this ability is **charged** for the rest of the turn increase the number of **melee** attacks by 1

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: You can give a Mark of Death to a number of **enemy** units equal to the amount of **friendly** units with this ability. **Friendly** models with this ability can re-roll failed **wound** rolls of 1 against **enemy** units with **Mark of Death**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If you use a **strategem** on this model before its shooting attack that give it a benefit for targeting a specific unit it applies to every unit this model targets.


[Example: If you used a **strategem** on this model that requires you to select 1 target and this model would gain +1 to hit against it instead all targets this model shoots act as if they where effected]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model has all these abilities:
- If this model is on more then 1 wound and an attack would cause it to fall below 1 wound it instead reduces it to 1 wound
- This models **Leadership** can not be modified
- At the end of your turn roll a D6 and on a 5+ restore 1 wound on this model
- This model counts as 4 for transport capacity

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **Models** with this ability have a **[Feel No Pain X+]** where x is the number in the ability against **Psychic** wounds from all sources

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When making a charge roll reduce the distance to **pinned** or **battleshocked** by 1" and improve the number of attacks this unit has by 1 when targetting thouse units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After this unit has charged select 1 enemy unit withing engagment range of this unit. Roll a dice for each model in this unit with this ability. On each 4+ the selected unit suffers 1 mortal wound

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this ability can be targeted by **Crushing Impact** strategem. When determining the number of dice to roll add up all the toughness of each models in this unit with this ability then half it rounded up. Use that number as the value for the number of dice to roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While there are 2 or more models with this ability in the same unit improve all model's [with this ability in that unit] **Invulnerable Save** by 1 to a maximum of 4+

sharedRules.name: Pinned
sharedRules.description: A **unit** that is **pinned** has -2" to its movment and advance and charge roll. This lasts for 1 **battle round**

sharedRules.name: Pinning
sharedRules.description: A unit that receives 1 or more damage from a weapon with this become **pinned**

sharedRules.name: Heal(x)
sharedRules.description:
When a unit is affected by this ability resolve the following X times
- If a model is below full wounds, restore 1 wound to it
- If every model is at full wounds and this unit has destroyed models, return 1 destroyed model to this unit with 1 wound remaining.

sharedRules.name: Overcharge
sharedRules.description: If a weapon with this ability makes a **hazardous** test -1 to the roll

sharedRules.name: Conversion
sharedRules.description: ach time an attack made with this weapon targets a unit more than half the weapons range from the bearer, an unmodified successful Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit.

sharedRules.name: Rad-Phage
sharedRules.description: A unit that has taken 1 or more wounds from a weapon with this ability have -1 toughness till the end of the phase but does not stack with itself but does with all other modifers.

sharedRules.name: Burst
sharedRules.description: If a weapon **succsesfully** hits its target every **sucsesful** hit triggers **[Sustained Hits]** even if its not a **critical Hits**. **Critical Hits** do not trigger this ability as they already trigger **[Sustained Hits]**

sharedRules.name: Achean Force
sharedRules.description:
Before a unit attacks with weapons with this ability and is not **battle-shocked** it can make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1 this unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: increase all **Achean Force** weapons in this unit **strength** by 2 for the rest of the phase
[You only make 1 roll for this per phase no matter how many weapons have this ability]
Weapons with this can not make a **psychic roll** due to the **psychic** weapon rule

sharedRules.name: Violence Incarnate
sharedRules.description: When a model with this rule **charges**  increase the number of **melee attacks** by 1 till the start of your next turn.

sharedRules.name: Remorseless
sharedRules.description: All non-**mounted** or **artillery** ignore modifiers to their **movement**,**advance** and **charges** and if the unit with this rule does not **advance**,**fall-back**, **Fly**, **Deep Strike** or **Disembark** it counts as remaning stationary even if its moved.

sharedRules.name: Medusa Scales
sharedRules.description: All incoming attacks have their **strength** reduced by 1

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Reconnaissaince and Scout Squads gain the **battleline** keyword
You can re-roll your roll to see who goes first
All vehciles with a toughness of 10 or more must be placed into resereves at the start of the game
You can not take any **fortifications**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Storm Hawk Gunships** gain the dedicated transport keyword
- You can use **Rapid Ingress** twice per battle round and it can be used in turn 1
- You may put up to all your army in **deep strike**
- All **Infantry** units must be withing a **transport** if they do not have the **jumpack** keyword
- All **Jumpack** models must be in **deep strike** at the start of the game
- You can not bring any non-**fly** vehicles or **fortifications**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Land Raider Proteus Carriers** become **Dedicated Transports**
- **Predators** become **Battleline**
- You must take 1 **Sicarian Master of Armour** or **Predator Master of Armour** in your army and it must be your warlord
- All **Infantry** units must enter battle **embarked** in a transport
- You can not take **Fortifications**
- You can not take this **detachment** as an allie force

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Contempter Dreadnoughts** gain **battleline** 
- You must take 1 **Venerable Ancient Contempter Dreadnought**
- You can not take any Charecters other then **Forge Lords**, **Primarius Medicare**, **Mortifactors** or **Tech Marines** not including **Retinues**
- You can not take any **fortifications**
- You can not take an ally
- You can not take this as an ally

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Veteran** and **Terminator** units gain the **Battleline** keyword
- This can not be taken in an ally
- All **vehicle** and **mounted** units have now a max of 1 in your army
- You can not take **fortifications**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Legion Sky-Hunter Squadrons** and **Legion Land Speeder Squadrons** become Battleline
- You can only bring **Fly Vehicles**
- All **Infantry** units must be embarked in a **Fly transport**
- This can not be taken in an Allied army
- This army can not have **Dreadnoughts** or **Fortifications**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Pyroclast Squads**,**Legion Tactical Support Squads** and **Legion Predator Squads** gain **battleline** but LTSS and LPS can only take Dragon Breath Weapons if they are **Battleline**
- You can not deploy **Deep Strike** models via **Deep Strike**
- You can not take any **Bitter Duty** units
- You must take a **Champion Charecter**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Legion Headhunter Kill Teams** gain the **battleline** keyword
- You gain +2VP if a **Alpha Legion** unit kills the enermy warlord
- During Turn 1 all **Alpha Legion** units gain a **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attack while more then 12" away from all enermy units.
- All **Vehicles** must be placed in reserves

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Terror Squad** and **Night Raptor Squad** gain **battleline**
- All units that do not have **Prey Sight** and/or **Night Vision** can not shoot further then 24". This lasts till the end of battleround 2
- All **friendly Night Lord Charecter** units gain **Legion of fear** or improve any leadership debuffs by 1
- This must be your primary army
- All vehicles are capped at 1 max
- You can not take **titanic** models

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy models withing 9" have -1 to their leadership charecteristic (So a 6+ would become a 7+)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- All **friendly Raven Guard** units gain **Charecter Killer** ability
- Any models that come out of **Reserves** or **Deep Strike** gain a **[Feel No Pain 5+]*8 against ranged attacks till the end of your opponents next turn.
- You gain +2VP if a **Friendly Raven Gaurd** unit kills the opponents **warlord**
- You can only bring a maximum of 1 of each vehicle/Dreadnought and no fortifications

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this ability can re-roll hit rolls of 1 when targeting **charecter** models

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Castellax-Achea** become **Battleline**
- When a **Friendly Psyker** withing 12" of a **Castellax-Achea** fails a **psychic roll** the effect can be transfered to the **Castellax-Achea**
- **Castellax-Achea** gain +1 OC when they are withing 9" of a **friendly Thousand Sons Psyker**
- **Castellax-Achea** must be in squads of 2 or more
- You must include 1 **Techmarine** in your army
- You must include 1 **Legion Praevian** in your army

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Legion Arquitor Squadrons** gain Battleline
- **[Indirect Fire]** weapons that benefit from a spotter now always miss on 1s and 2s if they would hit on 3s or better or normal hitting if they hit on a 4+
- All **Infantry** units gain **Stubborn Iron** ability
- You can not put any units into **reserves**
- You can not bring any **mounted** units
- You must bring 1 **Siege Breaker** in your army

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit can re-roll failed armour saves against **[blast]** weapon
